usage: 秋葵 is a common vegetable in Cantonese cuisine.
It is often cooked quickly to keep its crunchy texture.
秋葵 can be slimy when cooked, which some people like.
You can find 秋葵 in wet markets and supermarkets.
秋葵 is often stir-fried or boiled in soups.
